items.reason: A rinse-off wash that gives the strong blemish-clearing cleanse you asked for, with little time on the skin.
A fragrance-free ceramide moisturizer to offset dryness from the wash and support a comfortable skin barrier.

response.routine_note: Use the wash once a day at first, rinse well, then follow with the moisturizer; stepping down to the 2.5% wash is an option if skin feels tight. Because you are pregnant and the breakouts feel severe, please run any active products past your prenatal provider or a dermatologist, who can advise on more than a shop can.
